findings: Cold-start blast radius — The throw at module level in callback/route.ts crashes the entire Next.js cold-start when API_URL is absent, not just OAuth. Ensure API_URL is set in all Vercel environments (Production, Preview, Development) before deploying, and add it to the deploy checklist or .env.example.

Unconditional /api/me probe on login mount — The useEffect fetches /api/me on every mount, generating a 401 round-trip for every unauthenticated visitor. Consider a lightweight non-HttpOnly presence cookie to skip the probe for guests without exposing the session token to JS.
